validation_notes: From late June through early August, MSTR has been trading in a broad sideways range between roughly 90-104, with no clear convergence of highs and lows. Highs bounce between ~99-104 repeatedly without a consistent descending trendline, and lows oscillate between ~90-96 without a clean flat support line either. This looks more like a rectangular consolidation/range-bound market than a descending triangle. Near the right edge, price is still oscillating in the same ~93-99 band with no visible tightening of the range or apex formation. I don't see convincing evidence of compression required for a triangle pattern, so I disagree with the algorithm's descending triangle flag.
